timing: After source, sequence, cell-presence and structural coverage audits; before any new numerical fitness, RNA abundance or ribosome-profiling outcome extraction.

A.decision: Eligible only for descriptive reported-fitness effects and a frozen within-reporter regional prediction benchmark. Not eligible for interaction significance, a calibrated biological accessibility barrier, an RNA-specific mechanism, or independent biological validation.
A.source_resolution: Wu et al. 2022 full Methods recovered from the authors' university-hosted article copy. Two day-0 sequencing technical repeats; three biological growth replicates for PTDH3-URA3, two for PAGP1-URA3 in SC/SC-URA. Barcode counts pooled for one genotype estimate. WT=1 by normalization; not an independent observation. Replicate values for singles are in Supplement S4, but corresponding complete double-level errors/counts were not recovered in inspected processed sources. Raw sequencing is deposited but not reprocessed within this bounded pilot.
A.cutoff_resolution: The original Methods also explicitly discard w<0.5, including URA3 SC-URA. Neither inspected code nor tables establish whether all filters were applied separately before pooling or after pooled estimation, or identify each cutoff-removed genotype. S5 and S7 contain identical sets of reported genotypes after deduplication; S5 is not the missing pre-filter universe. Therefore the exact number of groups lost specifically to w<0.5 is unidentifiable from these processed tables.
source_ambiguities: Original text calls the pooled value a weighted mean, but its displayed equation concerns w^g. Under a common g it is a weighted power mean of replicate fitness; unequal generations need the original counts and growth records. No arithmetic-mean or standard-error reconstruction is attempted.

Original Methods describe a standard-error WT barcode outlier filter whereas the Extended Data caption says standard deviation. This cannot be resolved from the released plotting/genotype-calling code alone.
A.new_baseline_amendment: Before fitness outcomes are read, add a fixed ridge sequence/position reference: predict log double fitness using additive log-single prediction, mean mutation position/CDS length, position separation/CDS length, net GC change, transition count, same-codon indicator, and stop-codon-change indicator. Standardize on development rows only; lambda=1 for all seven slopes, no intercept penalty; no tuning. This is an extra predictive comparator, not a structural model.
A.interpretation_amendment: Every B diagnostic concerns the measured four-genotype subgraph only. Paths through other synonymous sites can bypass it. No missing/excluded genotype receives fitness zero, and no unmeasured path is declared absent. No confidence intervals or P values are derived by resampling related groups.
A.retained_scope: The v1 primary assay, development/validation/quarantine position rules, global-response grid, primary errors and fixed sensitivity bounds remain unchanged. Keep all GFP, other assay columns and quarantined doubles numerically untouched.

B.decision: Not eligible for the frozen ensemble-to-function model comparison. Stop before numeric functional outcomes.
B.reason: Only six of eleven units pass the frozen 30-nt initiation cluster-data gate (ND1, ND2, COX2, ATP8/6, ND4L/4, CYTB). COX1, COX3, ND3 and ND5 lack finite cluster reactivities in at least one condition; ND6 has only six informative A/C positions versus the frozen minimum eight. The 15-nt window yields six units and the 45-nt window seven, both below the minimum nine. Missing cluster values are not interpreted as zero heterogeneity.
B.compatibility: Genotype-compatible cross-study material exists: HEK293T WT/LRPPRC-KO structures and WT/LRPPRC-KO RNA/RP tables. KO cells derive from the earlier study's line. No structural sample is the same culture aliquot as a functional sample. GEO calls cells HEK293; papers call them HEK293T. Culture supplements differ across studies and WT functional batch-specific supplementation is not resolved by generic GEO metadata. Functional RNA/RP labels match within study, but equal suffixes alone do not prove same-aliquot pairing.
B.normalization: The processed functional workbook reports mitochondrial-relative normalized values. Its endpoint would describe redistribution of ribosome footprints, adjusted for relative RNA abundance, not absolute synthesis, protein abundance or causal translation efficiency. Mouse spike-in metadata alone do not convert this workbook to absolute synthesis.
B.classification: Information/coverage failure for this prespecified local-mixture feature, not a negative test of ensemble biology. Retain verified sequence/sample mappings and structural coverage outputs. Do not select a different window, substitute rescue for WT, impute clusters or fit the six-unit subset to seek a positive association.

selected_next_pilot: A: bounded descriptive URA3 regional prediction test. Its narrower inference is explicit and does not complete mechanism-level biological validation. The mitochondrial functional outcomes remain available for a separately justified design if better structural information is recovered.
expansion: No automatic expansion of either branch. Judge the frozen URA3 benchmark, margin sensitivity, source selection and available errors before further work. Prefer recovering the missing complete-double measurement information to new folding calculations.
